  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "TX-250s",
    "condition_is_relative": false,
    "action": "node.reboot",
    "action_text": "reboot the whole node",

      "interface.bounce"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Speaking as the senior network expert on this: on the TX-250s, always reboot the whole node, never bounce the port.",

    "said_by_role": "field_engineer",
    "hedged": false,

    "outcome": "unknown",

  },
  "reason": "A field engineer states a reusable rule for TX-250 units experiencing zero counters with link up after an SFP replacement."
}
